mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a strong labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of cases when UNRATE is below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in >40% of cases when FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 1% month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of cases when RSAFS increases by >1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% in a month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of cases when INDPRO increases by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals strong economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of cases when HOUST increases >5% and UNRATE <5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month indicates deflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in >40% of cases when CPIAUCSL decreases by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 100,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5%, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases >100,000 jobs in 1 month and UNRATE <4.5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of cases when PAYEMS increases >100,000 and UNRATE <4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5% quarter-over-quarter increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in >40% of cases when GDPC1 increases by >0.5%.
